# Commands

Every command gragas has decided on, from the one registry the program is built from. A command in the tree works now. A command that is not built yet is listed so that nothing in the help or the README promises it. Any command can also end usage, busy or not ready.

## In the tree

| Command | Context | Ends in | Writes | Closing words | JSON kind |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| validate | R | listing | nothing | done, findings | validate |
| migrate | R | plan | every file of the rulebook that changes format, history.jsonl | done, declined, not ready | plan |
| rule (new, edit, replace, retire, restore, renumber, promote, confirm, exclude, include) | R | plan | the concern's rules file, history.jsonl | done, declined, refused | plan |
| term (new, edit, retire) | R | plan | terms.yaml, history.jsonl | done, declined, refused | plan |
| source (new, edit) | R | plan | sources.yaml, history.jsonl | done, declined, refused | plan |
| decision (new, supersede) | R | plan | decisions.yaml, the rules files of the rules that move (supersede), history.jsonl | done, declined, refused | plan |
| undo | R | plan | the file of the entity the entry changed, history.jsonl | done, declined, refused, not ready | plan |
| guard (edit, staged) | R | listing | nothing | done, refused | guard |
| import | R | plan | the rules file of the concern it fills, sources.yaml, decisions.yaml, history.jsonl | done, declined | plan |
| attention | R | listing | nothing | done | attention |
| history | R | listing | nothing | done | history |
| bind | R | plan | the concern's rules file, or a record in bindings/ for a borrowed rule, history.jsonl | done, declined, refused, not ready | plan |
| rebind | R | plan | the concern's rules file, or a record in bindings/ for a borrowed rule, history.jsonl | done, declined, refused, not ready | plan |
| unbind | R | plan | the concern's rules file, history.jsonl | done, declined, refused, not ready | plan |
| conflicts | R | listing | nothing | done, findings | conflicts |
| coverage | R | listing | nothing | done | coverage |
| tools | B | listing | nothing | done | tools |
| plugin (test, contract, list, approve, add, upgrade, record) | B | listing | this machine's record of approvals (approve), plugins/<name>/<version>/ files and plugins/lock.yaml (add), plugins/<name>/<version>/ files and plugins/lock.yaml, and the replaced version's files removed (upgrade), plugins/<name>/<version>/testdata/ recordings and cases (record) | done, findings, not ready, refused, declined | plugin |
| resolve | B | listing | nothing | done, not ready | resolve |
| explain | B | listing | nothing | done | explain |
| preset | R | plan | presets/<tool>/ files | done, findings, declined, refused, not ready | plan |
| init | A | plan | the pin and the presets of a project, rulebook.yaml, structure.yaml and the first line of history.jsonl for a rulebook | done, declined, refused, not ready | plan |
| check | B | listing | nothing | done, findings | check |
| contract (validate, fields, fixture) | A | listing | the fixture's documents, with --apply | done, findings, not ready | contract |
| help | A | listing | nothing | done | help |
| version | A | listing | nothing | done | version |
| journal (list, recover, restore) | A | listing | the files an open run changed, and its record (recover) | done, refused | journal |
| cache (list, clear) | A | listing | the closed runs of the journal, the scratch folders a stopped run left and the tools' cache folders (clear) | done, refused | cache |
| gen | A | plan | rules.json | done, findings, declined, refused | plan |
